actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.DriveServices.list#FolderView').parameters({driveId: driveId || '', path: path || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {fileList: out.fileList, breadcrumbList: out.breadcrumbList})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.DriveServices.find#FileRows').parameters({view: 'search', text: text || '', limit: 50}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {fileList: out.fileList})
